news.title: What Is UW–Madison?
news.summary_en: For fans of both Jeopardy! and the UW, it’s a special thrill when the top-rated TV quiz show reveals a clue related to the university, which might happen more than you think!

news.title: UW–Madison in four walks
news.summary_en: Lush landscapes, iconic architecture, centuries of local history and meditative escapes. UW has it all along these scenic walks across campus.

news.title: Going long on Badger history
news.summary_en: In celebration of the Badgers–Fighting Irish game, UW Archives spent nine months unearthing treasures for a once-in-a-lifetime exhibit with the University of Notre Dame.
